## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5fe8c76d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml, .github/workflows/merged-branch-reaper.yml, .github/workflows/shard-timings-refresh.yml, .github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml, scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs, scripts/check-stall-guard-budget.mjs, scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.sh, scripts/import-prerequisite.mjs, scripts/sync-release-index-currency.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs + fleet-patrols.yml's job ids (L262/466/851/1176, read), scripts/check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs clause 7 (the cron-twin pin #26653, read for the L25 sentence)

Read at 2026-10-28T07:02Z by the `domain:skills#2` seat on the fetched head (merge-base `d8a9cc59`): 12 files, +36/−36. Tier H by path (`.github/workflows/**`); approval state at this write: approved by os-zhuang (review 5678918264, commit 5fe8c76d9). This record is the surface-owed review.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept set, no public surface, no behaviour moves: every changed line is a comment or a comment-string (the seat's diff filter for non-comment `+`/`−` lines returns nothing; `git diff --numstat` is line-neutral per file). `skip-changeset` is the right declaration.
- Each retired file name → `fleet-patrols.yml` plus its job id (`required-set-patrol`, `platform-checklist-watchdog`, `release-coverage-patrol`, `board-snapshot` — the job ids on the head's `fleet-patrols.yml`). The card's acceptance grep on the head: 0 hits in the objectstack tree outside `fleet-patrols.yml`'s own history rows (its L12–15 table and four 「formerly」 headers), `docs/audits/gate-census-2026-09.md` (a dated record, kept by design) and `ui/**` (the ui lane's tree). Correct.
- Two sentences corrected beyond a name swap, both measured: `lint.yml` L2542–2556 no longer claims the watchdog's `pull_request` filter names its file ALONE (the pin now reads a frozen set of the four patrols' inputs); `fleet-patrols.yml` L25 no longer says a one-sided cron edit reds nowhere (clause 7 of the watchdog pin, landed with #26653, refuses both shapes — the card's scope addendum 6440937713 assigned exactly this sentence to this sweep). Correct.
- Line neutrality was load-bearing: `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` pins `dispatch-gates.mjs:738` by line and `dist-freshness.test.ts` cites `import-prerequisite.mjs:250`; the dev's first swap added a line and the fast tier went red (1 of 1935), then re-cut line-neutral — green (`✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1935 cases pass`). The seat re-measured neutrality per file. Correct.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: workflows and repo scripts ship in no package; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body match the claim; no `Skills-docs:` line owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Beyond the claim's literal file list: `fleet-patrols.yml` L25 (the addendum's sentence) and L760 (a stale `required-set-patrol.yml` mention the acceptance grep requires gone) — same class, comment-only, bounded; the seat amends the claim's surface here rather than REWORK. No open PR touches `fleet-patrols.yml` (seat scan at this write); #27067's `lint.yml` hunks (typecheck job) are disjoint from L150 / L2542–2556.
- Out of card, listed by the dev: the `ui/**` hits (`ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` L47/L2684, `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts` L324, `ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` L236) — the seat routes them to the ui lane as a note (prose only, no runtime effect); `scripts/check-stall-guard-budget.mjs` L466's 「28 files, 51 jobs」 count is untouched drift (noted, not a card).
- Four gate families NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, unbuilt packages: doc-formula-expressions, doc-security-posture, dual-build-cjs-loads, lean-entry-closure) — CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs them on a built tree; read there before landing.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the reader the card names (a dev or seat following a comment to a workflow file): every pointer now resolves to a file and a job that exist; the two corrected sentences now describe the pins as they are. No assertion string changed (the self-test comments sit beside fixtures, not inside them). Holds.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-26525-retired-patrol-names`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 — 席位终稿 · PR #27122 · head `5fe8c76d` · `domain:skills#2` · 2026-10-28T07:03Z

- 改了什么:12 个文件里仍点名四个已退役巡检 workflow 文件的注释与说明,全部改指 `fleet-patrols.yml` 及对应 job;另改正两句已失真的说明——`lint.yml` 「watchdog 的 PR 过滤只点名它自己(ALONE)」、`fleet-patrols.yml` 「cron 单边改动哪儿都不红」(自 #26653 起有 clause 7 拦)。+36/−36,逐文件行数不变。
- 为什么改:#26071 (ii) 把四个巡检并进 `fleet-patrols.yml` 后,读这些注释的人会去找不存在的文件;两句失真说明会让人误判门禁覆盖。
- 风险与回滚:纯注释,零行为变化;行数中性是硬要求(自测按行号钉 `dispatch-gates.mjs:738`,dev 第一版多一行即红,改中性后绿)。回滚 = revert。
- 先看:`lint.yml` L2541–2558(watchdog 静态钉说明块)、`fleet-patrols.yml` L25、`scripts/check-stall-guard-budget.mjs` L458–461(复用 job id 的举例重新实测)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n -E 'required-set-patrol\.yml|platform-checklist-watchdog\.yml|release-coverage-patrol\.yml|board-snapshot\.yml' -- . ':!ui' ':!docs/audits'`,预期只剩 `fleet-patrols.yml` 自己的 8 行历史说明。
- 需要你做的:Tier H(`.github/workflows/**`)——请 Approve 或亲手入队(approved by os-zhuang (review 5678918264, commit 5fe8c76d9));之后席位落地。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。卡外剩余:`ui/**` 四处同类旧名(交 ui 车道一行留言)、`docs/audits` 一条(历史记录,不动)。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg` · 2026-10-28T07:03Z

1. 形态:目标 main,首行 `Fixes #26525`,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 行首在;12 文件 +36/−36;assignee os-justin;`skip-changeset` 正确;draft 位与请审由他人动,席位未动。
2. 前提实测:席位在取回的 head 上核——非注释改动零行;逐文件 `numstat` 加减相等;验收 grep 在 objectstack 树(排 fleet-patrols 历史行、ui/**、docs/audits)零命中;job id 四个在 `fleet-patrols.yml` 上存在;L25 句对应 clause 7(#26653)。
3. 门禁 check-runs(head `5fe8c76d`,本笔读数 2026-10-28T07:03Z):20 success · 14 skipped · 13 in progress;dev 本地并集 73/77 exit 0、4 条 exit 3(未建包的前置,CI 的 Lint & Repo Gates 跑)。落地前席位再读全绿。
4. 接受的偏差:① `fleet-patrols.yml` L25/L760 在认领字面面之外——L25 是卡上 addendum 6440937713 划进本卡的句子,L760 是验收 grep 要求清掉的;席位在此把认领文件面修正为含 `fleet-patrols.yml` 注释;② 三个 commit + 一个 merge commit(为行数中性返工);③ 4 族本地 NOT MEASURED(declared narrowing)。
5. 范围外去向:`ui/**` 四处 → 席位留言 ui 车道(非三类,不立卡);`docs/audits` → 不动;`check-stall-guard-budget.mjs` L466 计数漂移 → Acceptance notes。`Skills-docs:` 不欠(kind none)。
6. 落地条款:Tier H ⇒ 等 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 批准(approved by os-zhuang (review 5678918264, commit 5fe8c76d9));契约复核 PASS 评论 6462862352 钉 head;批准在案后席位跑 `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27122`、核全绿与 `mergeable_state` 再经中继落地(分类器若拦,照 #26997 的记录停手报维护者)。

## Seat note — `Nightly tiers (2/2)` red on this head is main's failure, not this PR's

Reading taken 2026-10-28T07:22Z by `domain:skills#2` (seat post #19287).

- Failing check: `Nightly tiers (2/2)` (workflow `test-nightly-tiers.yml`, `pull_request` run 40647023027, job 122678103465, head `5fe8c76d9a`). Step "Run this shard's nightly tiers": `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta.e2e.test.ts` — 6 of 19 failed, 322/328 passed; `check-test-completeness: OK`.
- Same failure on `main` without this PR: scheduled run 40638682260 on `76e90df613` (created 2026-10-28T05:33Z), job 122651489486, same shard, same file, the same six tests with the same six assertions (`expected a rewrite from action-execute-to-target; got sharing-rule-access-level-full-to-edit`, `unrecognized_keys ["responsive","performance"] at views[0].list`, `expected undefined to be 'agents[0].knowledge'`, …). The prior five nightlies on main (10-23 … 10-27) were green.
- This PR's only change to that workflow is one `#` comment line (`platform-checklist-watchdog.yml` → `fleet-patrols.yml`'s job, the retired-name rewrite this card is about); no test, fixture or CLI source is touched. Diff-to-failure path: none.
- The workflow's `report` job already filed the red card: #27114 `nightly-tiers: red on main` (`domain:devx`, `priority:p1`, `pm:dispatched` — in flight on the devx lane). No fix PR exists yet to port into this PR; when #27114 lands, this check goes green on main by itself.
- `Nightly Tiers` runs on `schedule` / `workflow_dispatch` / `pull_request` only — it is not a `merge_group` workflow and not in the queue's required set; the merge-queue runs for this PR (`CI`, `Lint & Type Check`, `Governed Surface Guard`, `Spec Liveness Check`, `PR-Body Guards`) are the gate. The PR is in the queue, approved by `os-zhuang`.
- Not re-running the shard: the failure is reproduced on main's own run with identical assertions, so a second 25-minute run of this shard would confirm nothing.

Nothing for this PR to do; it stays in the queue.

One test: `examples/app-showcase/test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` → Playwright `e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` 「ungrouped + related-heavy: flat details and related-list tabs on Contoso」 — `getByRole('tab', { name: /Details/i })` not found (L164), retried once, 52 of 53 smoke tests passed; `check-test-completeness: OK` (562 declared, all accounted for).

- Anchor card: #27114 `nightly-tiers: red on main` is the one card for the `Nightly tiers` check (fixed title, refreshed nightly). This reading is posted there for the ui lane; no second card.
- The `pull_request` run of this workflow never writes, and the workflow is not in the merge queue's required set, so this PR's queue entry is unaffected. Not re-running the shard (same reason as above: main's own path shows the failure, a 36-minute re-run of the shard confirms nothing).
